create_complex_stft_extractor: create a ComplexSTFT module to compute the complex STFT of audio tensors with a configurable window function
invert_complex_stft_spectrogram: invert a complex spectrogram tensor back to audio waveform using the ComplexSTFT invert method
build_amplitude_compressed_stft: build an AmplitudeCompressedComplexSTFT pipeline that applies STFT followed by amplitude compression and scaling
compress_and_scale_spectrogram: create a CompressAmplitudesAndScale module to compress amplitudes with an exponent and scale a complex spectrogram
chain_invertible_extractors: create an InvertibleSequential module to chain multiple invertible feature extractors in forward and reverse order
